purpose: Resolve a genuinely unfinished precision prerequisite for the legal K64 A4/W4 path without relaxing the old floating-division oracle.
prior_failure: r742 stopped on 34 hidden activation code differences out of 7864320 before complete timing; r751 observed DivF near-half differences. Both results remain failures under their original contract.

new_contract.input: Finite BF16 values, subnormals flushed to zero, one independent row per quantization scale.
new_contract.amax: A = max(2^-112, max(abs(x))) after FTZ; A is exactly representable BF16.
new_contract.code: sign(x) * floor(7 * abs(x) / A + 1/2), bounded to [-7,7]; division here is exact rational arithmetic.
new_contract.reconstruction_scale: RN32(A * RN32(1/7)); explicitly separate from code selection and from old DivF scale semantics.
new_contract.integer_implementation: For normalized BF16 x=Mx*2^(ex-134), A=Ma*2^(ea-134), delta=ea-ex. If delta>=5 or x is FTZ zero, return 0. Otherwise count 14*Mx >= (2*k+1)*(Ma<<delta) for k=0..6 and restore sign.

expected_removed_work: No floating division in code selection, therefore no ambiguous floating quotient at a mathematical half-tie.
expected_added_work: Integer exponent/mantissa extraction, comparison/shift operations, scale construction and required dense I32-to-I4 packing; actual device cost is unknown.
cpu_gate: Independent Fraction nearest-code oracle for every normalized mantissa pair with relevant exponent difference; finite-BF16 boundary cases, signs, FTZ and floor; exact nearest non-tie threshold distance.
device_gate: Not authorized by this plan alone: first obtain a concrete public-operation schedule and inclusive cost bound. Any floating bias alternative requires a separate actual error/correctness gate, not an assumed DivF bound.
complete_gate: Quantize, scale, pack, real H/L layouts, launch boundaries, supplied-weight FFN and actual model quality must all be measured before adoption. A projection-only speedup or INT4 hardware peak is insufficient.
